name: Shuuren no Juunigatsu
source:
Tying the legends together, the stage is set in the city where the God lives.
This is the final chapter in the heartful love novel series.
Yuki and Shiro have disappeared. In order to get them, and his regular everyday life, back... Masaki makes his move.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE036736.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
傳說彼此交匯，故事的舞臺正是神明居住的小鎮。
這是溫馨戀愛小說系列的最終章。
雪與白已經消失。為了找回她們，也為了奪回往日平靜的生活……柾木開始行動。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE036736.html]DLSite[/url]]
